_meta.topic: OpenAI Daybreak + Patch the Planet (cyber initiative + GPT-5.5-Cyber full release)
_meta.notes: Both pages mined via Playwright MCP (Cloudflare bot gate blocked WebFetch/curl). Daybreak (Jun 22 2026) releases full GPT-5.5-Cyber with new SOTA CyberGym 85.6% (vs preview 81.9% / GPT-5.5 81.8%). Codex Security stats: 30M+ commits scanned, 30K+ codebases, 70K+ findings fixed by human reviewers, 500K+ auto-fixed. Patch the Planet initiative with Trail of Bits + HackerOne + Calif covers 19 OSS projects; initial public participants: cURL, NATS Server, pyca/cryptography, Sigstore, aiohttp, Go, freenginx, Python, python.org. Real-world findings: Linux Kernel 8 info-leak + 24 LPE PoCs / OpenBSD 23-year UAF / FreeBSD 34 vulns + 7 LPE / dnsmasq 4 CVEs / HTTP/2 Bomb (880K+ sites) / Chrome V8 5 vulns / Safari 10+ vulns / Firefox CVE-2026-8390.
